query.statement: SELECT PLANT_ID, PLANT_NAME, DESCRIPTION, COUNTRY, TIME_ZONE FROM MDM_PLANT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) ORDER BY PLANT_NAME

SELECT EQUIPMENT_ID, EQUIPMENT_NAME, PLANT_ID, AREA_ID, EQUIPMENT_TYPE, EQUIPMENT_CLASS_ID, VALID_STATE FROM MDM_EQUIPMENT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE PLANT_ID = @plantId AND (@validState IS NULL OR VALID_STATE = @validState) ORDER BY EQUIPMENT_ID

INSERT INTO MDM_PLANT (PLANT_ID, PLANT_NAME, DESCRIPTION, COUNTRY, TIME_ZONE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@plantId, @plantName, @description, @country, @timeZone, @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow)
SELECT PLANT_ID, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_BY FROM MDM_PLANT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE PLANT_ID = @plantId
SELECT PLANT_ID AS VALUE, PLANT_NAME AS TEXT FROM MDM_PLANT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) ORDER BY PLANT_NAME
SELECT AREA_ID AS VALUE, AREA_NAME AS TEXT FROM MDM_AREA WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) ORDER BY AREA_NAME
SELECT AREA_ID, AREA_NAME, DESCRIPTION, PLANT_ID FROM MDM_AREA WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) ORDER BY AREA_NAME
SELECT PRODUCT_ID AS VALUE, PRODUCT_NAME AS TEXT FROM MDM_PRODUCT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE VALID_STATE = 'Valid' AND (@productType IS NULL OR PRODUCT_TYPE = @productType) ORDER BY PRODUCT_NAME
SELECT PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, DESCRIPTION, PRODUCT_TYPE, UNIT, VALID_STATE FROM MDM_PRODUCT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@validState IS NULL OR VALID_STATE = @validState) ORDER BY PRODUCT_NAME
SELECT CODE_CLASS_ID, CODE_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION FROM MDM_CODE_CLASS WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY CODE_CLASS_NAME
SELECT CODE_ID AS VALUE, CODE_NAME AS TEXT FROM MDM_CODE WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CODE_CLASS_ID = @codeClassId AND VALID_STATE = 'Valid' ORDER BY SORT_ORDER, CODE_NAME
SELECT EQUIPMENT_ID AS VALUE, EQUIPMENT_NAME AS TEXT FROM MDM_EQUIPMENT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) ORDER BY EQUIPMENT_NAME

SELECT EQUIPMENT_ID, EQUIPMENT_NAME, PLANT_ID, AREA_ID, EQUIPMENT_TYPE, EQUIPMENT_CLASS_ID, VALID_STATE FROM MDM_EQUIPMENT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@validState IS NULL OR VALID_STATE = @validState) ORDER BY EQUIPMENT_NAME

SELECT CODE_ID, CODE_NAME, CODE_CLASS_ID, SORT_ORDER, VALID_STATE FROM MDM_CODE WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@codeClassId IS NULL OR CODE_CLASS_ID = @codeClassId) ORDER BY CODE_CLASS_ID, SORT_ORDER, CODE_NAME
SELECT EQUIPMENT_CLASS_ID, EQUIPMENT_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION FROM MDM_EQUIPMENT_CLASS WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY EQUIPMENT_CLASS_NAME
SELECT ITEM_CLASS_ID, ITEM_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION FROM MDM_ITEM_CLASS WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY ITEM_CLASS_NAME
SELECT CARRIER_CLASS_ID, CARRIER_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION FROM MDM_CARRIER_CLASS WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY CARRIER_CLASS_NAME
SELECT CARRIER_ID, CARRIER_NAME, CARRIER_CLASS_ID, DESCRIPTION FROM MDM_CARRIER WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY CARRIER_NAME
SELECT SEGMENT_CLASS_ID, SEGMENT_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION FROM MDM_SEGMENT_CLASS WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY SEGMENT_CLASS_NAME
SELECT SEGMENT_ID, SEGMENT_NAME, SEGMENT_CLASS_ID, DESCRIPTION FROM MDM_SEGMENT WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY SEGMENT_NAME
SELECT PROCESS_CLASS_ID, PROCESS_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION FROM MDM_PROCESS_CLASS WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY PROCESS_CLASS_NAME
SELECT PROCESS_ID, PROCESS_NAME, PROCESS_CLASS_ID, DESCRIPTION FROM MDM_PROCESS WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY PROCESS_NAME
SELECT ROUTING_ID, ROUTING_NAME, PRODUCT_ID, DESCRIPTION FROM MDM_ROUTING WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY ROUTING_NAME
SELECT BOM_ID, PRODUCT_ID, COMPONENT_ID, QUANTITY FROM MDM_BOM WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY BOM_ID
SELECT QTIME_ID, SEGMENT_ID, STANDARD_TIME, UNIT FROM MDM_QTIME WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY QTIME_ID
SELECT ACTION_ID, QTIME_ID, ACTION_CODE, DESCRIPTION FROM MDM_QTIME_ACTION WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY ACTION_ID
SELECT WORKER_CLASS_ID, WORKER_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM MDM_WORKER_CLASS WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY WORKER_CLASS_NAME

SELECT WORKER_ID, WORKER_NAME, WORKER_CLASS_ID, EMPLOYEE_NO, DEPARTMENT, PLANT_ID, IS_ACTIVE FROM MDM_WORKER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@workerClassId IS NULL OR WORKER_CLASS_ID = @workerClassId) ORDER BY WORKER_NAME
SELECT SHIFT_ID, SHIFT_NAME, START_TIME, END_TIME, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM MDM_SHIFT WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY SHIFT_ID
SELECT CALENDAR_ID, CALENDAR_DATE, DAY_TYPE, SHIFT_ID, PLANT_ID, DESCRIPTION FROM MDM_WORK_CALENDAR WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY CALENDAR_DATE DESC
SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER_NAME, CUSTOMER_TYPE, CONTACT_NAME, PHONE, ADDRESS, IS_ACTIVE FROM MDM_CUSTOMER WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY CUSTOMER_NAME

SELECT DELIVERY_ITEM_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, DELIVERY_CODE, UNIT_PRICE, IS_ACTIVE FROM MDM_DELIVERY_ITEM WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@customerId IS NULL OR CUSTOMER_ID = @customerId) ORDER BY CUSTOMER_ID, PRODUCT_ID
SELECT LABEL_ID, PLANT_ID, LABEL_NAME, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM MDM_LABEL WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) ORDER BY LABEL_NAME

SELECT TOP 500 ISSUE_ID, PLANT_ID, LABEL_ID, ITEM_ID, LOT_ID, SERIAL_NUM, PRINT_CNT, ISSUED_AT FROM MDM_LABEL_ISSUE WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@labelId IS NULL OR LABEL_ID = @labelId) ORDER BY ISSUED_AT DESC

SELECT MAPPING_ID, PLANT_ID, PROCESS_ID, ITEM_ID, LABEL_ID, PRINT_LIMIT_CNT, PRINT_LIMIT_YN FROM MDM_LABEL_MAPPING WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@labelId IS NULL OR LABEL_ID = @labelId) ORDER BY LABEL_ID, PROCESS_ID

SELECT BOR_ID, PLANT_ID, BOR_NAME, PROCESS_ID, PRODUCT_ID, BOR_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM MDM_BOR WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@borType IS NULL OR BOR_TYPE = @borType) ORDER BY BOR_NAME

SELECT RESOURCE_ID, BOR_ID, RESOURCE_TYPE, RESOURCE_REF_ID, RESOURCE_NAME, REQUIRED_QTY, CONDITION_VALUE, IS_ACTIVE FROM MDM_BOR_RESOURCE WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@borId IS NULL OR BOR_ID = @borId) AND (@resourceType IS NULL OR RESOURCE_TYPE = @resourceType) ORDER BY BOR_ID, RESOURCE_TYPE

SELECT VENDOR_ID, VENDOR_NAME, VENDOR_TYPE, CORPORATION_NO, OWNER_NAME, PHONE, EMAIL, ADDRESS, IS_ACTIVE FROM MDM_VENDOR WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@vendorType IS NULL OR VENDOR_TYPE = @vendorType) ORDER BY VENDOR_NAME

SELECT VENDOR_ITEM_ID, VENDOR_ID, PRODUCT_ID, LEAD_TIME_DAYS, MOQ, BASE_PRICE, IS_ACTIVE FROM MDM_VENDOR_ITEM WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@vendorId IS NULL OR VENDOR_ID = @vendorId) ORDER BY VENDOR_ID, PRODUCT_ID
